title: Replant Mod
description: Allows you to right click your crops with a custom enchant on hoes!
body:
# JubeTweaks Replant Mod!

In this mod it allows you to enchant your hoe with an enchant to harvest your crops with right click!

From Replant 1-3 you can harvest sizes 1x1, 3x3, and 5x5. 

All enchants can be found in the Enchanting Table OR from Librarian Villagers!

Thank you so much for downloading :3
